finding.verdict: e4-long-road CANNOT be secured through the post-ADR-005 door, by any policy, on this seed.
chain: Secure gate: HeadlessContractSim.ts:2354 ANDs `this.motor.objectiveAllowsSecure` into every wave, and :1493 refuses pendingSecure without it, so no wave count secures this claim until the convoy errand latches.
Convoy latch: MotorSocket.ts:345 wants `leader >= convoy.total - 1e-6` with total = 370; leaderDistance is round3()'d, so the real tolerance is bestRemaining <= 0.0005 wu from the stop at (190,0).
leaderDistance only ever gains `max(0, bestRemaining - hypot(hauler - stop))` (MotorSocket.ts:340-343), so the lead Hauler must physically come within 0.0005 wu of (190,0).
HAUL now drives the Hauler to the HERO's float position (HeadlessContractSim.ts:3107 -> MotorSocket.haulTo(this.hero.group.position)). Nothing else positions it.

MOVE_HERO refuses the stop as UNREACHABLE_TERRAIN. Measured this ride from a hero 8wu away: (190,0), (190,-3), (190,1.2) and (188.7,0) all refused; (191.1,0) accepted, hero came to rest at (191.070, -0.355).

Even on legal ground the hero cannot be placed exactly: MOVE_HERO marks its record `done` at HERO_ARRIVE_RADIUS 0.5, StandingOrders.tick clears heroSteer every tick, and Hero.update then decelerates asymptotically (velocity.lerp toward 0 at rate 28) with NO arrival snap.

The retired MOVE_TO/HOLD steered the PROSPECTOR, and Embodiment.stepTowardTarget:271-273 snaps `position.x = target.x; position.z = target.z` exactly on arrival. That exact snap is how generation 18 put the Hauler on (190,0) and secured this contract w12/360.000s (verified fnv1a32:e19c63ab, rank 1, 2026-09-03).

measured.note: 0.354 of the 0.359 shortfall is the hero's residual z offset; the along-track sampling error was ~0.06. Both are orders of magnitude above the 0.0005 tolerance.

finding.publishedButUnused: now.motor.objective.stopReach is 2.5 on this contract and reads like the tolerance; for kind 'convoy' nothing consumes it. MotorSocket.nearStop()/stopReach gate only kind 'haul' (line 309) and kind 'tow' (line 406). A rider that trusts the published field plans for 2.5wu and needs 1e-6.
finding.cheapestFix: Either latch the convoy on MOTOR_STOP_REACH like `haul` and `tow` already do, or make the railhead ground at (190,0) walkable so MOVE_HERO can stand on it. Neither is a balance change; both are one clause.
